verdict.rationale: The evidence shows GrowthBook has a REST API with documented endpoints, and its command palette can jump to API endpoints. Nothing shows an interactive API reference with runnable or try-it examples, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec at the common paths. A documented REST API is adjacent to this story, not the interactive explorer it asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
